extraction_notes: P-channel table values and plotted quantities are recorded as positive magnitudes where the datasheet uses negative signs; axis quantities retain the magnitude semantics shown by -VDS, -VGS, and -ID labels.
Transfer, on-region, and capacitance points are direct manual readings from the usable typical plots on pages 3-4; no interpolation was used.

The datasheet provides no typical threshold value, no gate-resistance row, and no RDS(on)-versus-temperature table field required by this extraction schema; unavailable schema fields are null or omitted as permitted.
